newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway debt weakens, but spread to Bund narrows.
newsitem.headline: Norway debt weakens, but spread to Bund narrows.

text.p: 1400 GMT -- Norwegian bond yields rose with German Bunds in reaction to U.S. developments, but the spread narrowed as the crown firmed in the morning, dealers said.
"The morning was very active with big movements but things cooled down considerably after a while," one dealer said.

Chase Investment Bank in a monthly outlook dated May 12 forecast that the crown, which has depreciated recently from four-year highs, would recover in the medium term. This would mean that the crown would be seen at 3.95-4.00 against the mark in the next few months, it said.

The crown lost some ground in the afternoon and was fixed at 101.81 against the inverse European Currency Unit index at 1400 GMT, versus 101.93 at the same time on Wednesday. The crown was pegged against the mark at 4.1570 versus 4.1555.
* 2007 bond yield five basis points higher at 6.05 pct
* Norway over Bunds gap two points narrower at 18 points
* Three-month eurokrone two points lower at 3.44 pct
